violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (various pots/pan and mandoline) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC placed items in 3 bay sink to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front community room, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2025
Inspector observed leak coming from 3 bay sink faucet. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
